rows.abstract:
Seeks to lower the corporate tax rate through rationalizing the administration of tax incentives which shall be performance-based, target, time-bound and transparent.

Aims to widen the corporate tax base and plug its tax leakages; and to rationalize and discipline tax incentives to ensure the benefits investments would bring and help alleviate financial burden on the business community, especially the micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 38, 39 AND 40 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 4566 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CONTRACTORS´ LICENSE LAW
rows.abstract:
Intends to rectify existing infirmities in R.A.No.4566, as amended by P.D.No.1746 which provides that no
contractor shall engage in the business of contracting without first having secured a Phil. Contractors 
Accreditation Board (PCAB) license to conduct business.

Seeks to propose several amendments among others such as: a) Violation shall be penalized with a fine of not less than P50,000.00 where the cost of the project is not more than P500,000,000.00; and a fine of not less than P500,000.00 where the cost of the project is more than P500,000,000.00; b) The bidder shall be automatically disqualified for award of contract; c) Higher fees for licensing, registration of application, and renewal shall be implemented: P5,000.00 for an original license; P6,000.00 for examination of an applicant; P5,000.00 for annual renewal.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07808

rows.author: H002
rows.title_full: AN ACT UNIFYING ALL EXISTING AGRICULTURAL CREDIT PROGRAMS FOR THE FARMERS, FISHERFOLK AND MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES (MSMEs) ENGAGED IN AGRICULTURAL AND FISHERIES, CREATING THE FARMERS AND FISHERFOLK QUICK CREDIT PROGRAM, ESTABLISHING THE AGRICULTURAL CREDIT AUTHORITY OF THE PHILIPPINES (ACAP), AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, IN ORDER TO PROMOTE THE DEVELOPMENT OF ENTREPRENEURSHIP IN THE AGRICULTURE AND FISHERIES SECTORS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to consolidate existing agricultural credit programs for MSMEs, thereby creating a lending facility which shall provide small farmers, fisherfolk and MSMEs in the agriculture and fisheries sectors direct, 
adequate, affordable, and timely credit for their farming and fishing activities.

Defines MSME in agriculture-related business activities among others; and states that FFQCP loan shall be provided with no collateral at a low interest rate and with minimal documentary/identification requirements.

Intends that FFQCP shall provide grant/financing assistance for the relief and rehabilitation of concerned
stakeholders engaged in agriculture/fisheries affected by calamities/fortuitous events; and provide grants and other subsidies for their education, institution capacity building activities, and training asregards to credit awareness, loan acquisition, loan repayment and on financial literacy.
rows.alias_name: "Farmers, Fisherfolk and MSMEs Engaged in Agriculture/Fisheries Quick Credit Act of 2019"
